editorial: Imagine a road trip that turns the city into a playground of plush and pixel, inviting you to step into a world where toys come alive. What makes this film unique is its hybrid animation, blending 3‑D plush figures with hand‑drawn cityscapes in a way that feels both familiar and fresh. A standout moment is the dollhouse sprouting wings and soaring above the skyline, turning an ordinary toy into a soaring spectacle of color and motion. If you love to laugh and dream alongside your family, this adventure invites you to play along.
targetAudience: Ideal for family movie nights with curious kids who love animated quests.
